# Who cares

**Constituencies.** Positively: "lots of generative ai folk" who with "basic grasp of ai" can "dive in and just have fun"; "the nervous hitchhikers" who came "along with the journey but didn't have the confidence to ask claude about it yet"; "people who hate facebook" and "people on facebook but feel they can't leave"; "people who really want to design a better interface to how we interact with power"; lawyers "like andrea" who say "the way that law is crafted... is designed badly"; a "fresh punky" design community that wants to believe it "can uh compete with facebook"; "the marvin tour people"; artists, designers and "music labels" connecting "musicians with their fans." Negatively: "facebook has a problem with that" once you have a platform that is "completely updatable."

**Nuance or tension.** Inversion on the base: "don't they love facebook... no they fucking hate it." Audiences "believe in the ideals but don't believe it's possible because everything looks like an open source pile of shit." They "don't want to hear more theory" but ask "what the does it look like... can i use it right?"
